preconditions.description: The value of k is between 2 and 12, inclusive.
The length of the array a is 2^k.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < 2**k for x in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a is between 0 and 2^k - 1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Fou' or (return_value == 'Shi' and len(p) == 2**k and len(q) == 2**k and all(0 <= x < 2**k for x in p) and all(0 <= x < 2**k for x in q) and len(set(p)) == 2**k and len(set(q)) == 2**k and all(p[i] ^ q[i] == a[i] for i in range(2**k)))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Fou', no such permutations exist. If the output is 'Shi', two permutations p and q of length 2^k with distinct elements between 0 and 2^k - 1 are provided such that p_i ⊕ q_i equals a_i for all i.
